# Inkscape

> Inkscape is a free, open-source vector graphics editor for creating and editing SVG artwork with professional design tools and an active community.

Inkscape serves as a comprehensive platform for vector graphics creation, offering tutorials, community galleries, source code releases, and user support forums. The site brings together designers, artists, and developers through its Inkspace gallery, documentation, and collaborative resources.

## Key Topics

- SVG (Scalable Vector Graphics)
- Vector Graphics
- Vector Art
- Path Transformation
- Shape Morphing
- Inkscape Extensions
- Artwork Gallery
- Creative Commons
- User Community
- Design Resources
- Interpolation
- Branding Assets
- Open Source
- Inkscape 1.4

## Downloads & Releases

- [Inkscape 1.4 - Source](https://inkscape.org/ar/release/inkscape-1.4/source/): Inkscape 1.4 source code release for download and compilation

## Learning & Tutorials

- [Inkscape Tutorial: Interpolation](https://inkscape.org/cs/doc/interpolate/tutorial-interpolate.ru.html): Tutorial on path interpolation and shape morphing in Inkscape

## Community & Artwork

- [Artwork - Inkspace Gallery](https://inkscape.org/cs/*inkscape-vectors/resources/=artwork/): Community gallery showcasing user-created Inkscape vector artwork
- [Shades - User Artwork](https://inkscape.org/de/~artist_40/★shades): User artwork submission in Inkspace gallery featuring color studies

## Support & Forums

- [Reset to Default - Beginners' Questions](https://inkscape.org/forums/questions/reset-to-default/): Forum discussion on resetting Inkscape settings to defaults
